posts.author: Not-Red
posts.body:
Introduction
By default, RPG Maker MV resets a state's walking-removal counter whenever that state is reapplied.
This plugin allows different behaviors when reapplying a state.
Features
Allows you to change how a state is reapplied using note tags, or using a default set in the plugin's parameters.
How to Use
Add the note tag <reapplyrule:x> to the states you want to change
Where x is;
0 = Ignore
Reapplying the state does nothing.
Remaining steps continue counting down normally.
1 = Reset
Reapplying resets remaining steps to the database value.
2 = Add
Reapplying adds the database value onto remaining steps.
By default, any state without a note tag will use "Reset", but this can be changed in the plugin parameters.
Download
Terms and Credits
Edit the plugin code as much as you like, I've done my best to make it as easy as possible to add new rules. Just don't republish it claiming the plugin as your own.
Free for commercial use with no credit required, though I won't stop you if you do.
